text: こんなに　ひろいと　どっちが　でぐちか　まよっちゃう

structure.jp: こんなに　ひろいと
どっちが　でぐちか

structure.en: I end up at a loss

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain word means 'when this is so, that follows'. こんなに　ひろいと = 'when it's this big'.

patterns.name: 〜か (question inside a sentence)
patterns.span: どっちが　でぐちか
patterns.explanation: か after a phrase with a question word turns it into a question tucked inside a bigger sentence. どっちが　でぐちか = 'which way is the exit'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing ends up happening when you don't want it to; ちゃう is its casual short form. まよっちゃう = 'I end up lost'.
